title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Monday, 24 August 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Indonesia’s nickel production cuts are not enough to create a sustainable industry
highlights.summary: The government is restricting nickel production to push up prices but producing more sustainable nickel for a premium requires addressing the industry's coal issue The post Indonesia’s nickel production cuts are not enough to create a sustainable industry appeared first on Climate Home News.

highlights.headline: Commission proposes fishing opportunities for 2027 in the Baltic Sea
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 24 Aug 2026 Today, the Commission adopted its proposal for the 2027 fishing opportunities for the Baltic Sea. The proposal sets the total allowable catches (TACs) and quotas for the ten EU-managed fish stocks in the Baltic Sea: Bothnian herring, central Baltic herring, Gulf of Riga herring, sprat, plaice, Main Basin salmon, Gulf of Finland salmon, western Baltic cod, eastern Baltic cod, and western Baltic herring.

items.title: US: Wildfire forces mass evacuations near Reno, Nevada
items.description: A wind-driven wildfire has forced roughly 42,000 people to evacuate and destroyed homes as fire crews continue to battle extreme conditions.
